description: Get the full detail of one specific check by id, shown as evidence the user can inspect: before/after screenshots with a comparison slider, the highlighted difference, the AI summary of what changed, extracted values (current + previous), and the full HTML copy Monity kept of the page. pageAccess says what the browser reached; when reachedContent is false the check saw a challenge, login or error page, so report that, not a change in content. Each call shows the check to the user as a card: call it once per check, and not for a check another result already shows (get_latest_result does). When you link to a check, use its checkUrl (its comparison in monity.ai), never the raw screenshot, diff or HTML file URLs.
name: get_check
title: Get check detail
